title: Skills vs MCP vs Tools (what most people understand)

cues.en: Hi, and welcome to an AI and C-Sharp video about tools, skills, and MCPs, and why most
cues.zh: 大家好，這支 C# AI 教學影片要介紹工具、技能與 MCP，以及為什麼大多數，

cues.en: people misunderstand the difference and how they actually work behind the scenes.
cues.zh: 人誤解了它們的差異，還有背後真正的運作方式。

cues.en: I've been wanting to make this video for quite a while, mostly because, as it says here, people misunderstand how they work.
cues.zh: 我想做這支影片已經很久了，主要就是因為大家常常誤解它們如何運作。

cues.en: They also misunderstand how AI contact providers work behind the scenes, but I'm going to round to it.
cues.zh: AI Context Provider 的內部運作也經常被誤解，稍後會一起介紹。

cues.en: But there has been some sources that have led me to make this video.
cues.zh: 有幾件事促使我製作這支影片。

cues.en: The first one is a fairly old one, and that is that at some point MCPs became the bad guy.
cues.zh: 第一件是比較早以前的事：不知何時開始，MCP 被當成了壞東西。

cues.en: They were using a lot of tokens and stuff, and skills were the new big thing.
cues.zh: 大家說它會花費很多 Token，而技能才是最新、最好的方向。

cues.en: They were much better and used almost no tokens, which is technically correct in some situations,
cues.zh: 技能好用許多，幾乎不花 Token。某些情況下，技術上確實如此，

cues.en: but that is what we will get into.
cues.zh: 但這正是我們要深入探討的。

cues.en: At the same time, the skills were implemented as an AI contact provider.
cues.zh: 同時，技能被實作成 AI Context Provider。

cues.en: If you don't know AI contact provider, that's an additional thing you can insert into an
cues.zh: 如果不熟悉 AI Context Provider，它是可以加入，

cues.en: agent in Microsoft Agent Framework that can do pre- and post-injection of various things into an LLM.
cues.zh: Microsoft Agent Framework 代理程式的元件，在呼叫 LLM 前後注入各種內容。

cues.en: It's mostly used for memory, for example, but it can be used for a lot of other things, and the Microsoft Agent Framework team use it for quite a lot.
cues.zh: 常用於記憶等功能，但也能處理很多其他事情，Agent Framework 團隊大量採用。

cues.en: In my opinion, too much, but we will get into that throughout the video.
cues.zh: 在我看來有點過度使用，不過整支影片會逐步說明。

cues.en: But this was one of them that, okay, we shouldn't use MCPs anymore, they are just bad.
cues.zh: 這是第一個常見說法：不應該再使用 MCP，它們就是不好。

cues.en: In my opinion, no, but I will explain.
cues.zh: 我不同意，稍後會解釋。

cues.en: Second was a question from a recent video about Zero2Rack.
cues.zh: 第二件事是最近 Zero to RAG 影片下的一個問題。

cues.en: So I have blurted out the person who asked it because I haven't gotten their permission, but since they just said, thank you for the video, I have a question.
cues.zh: 因為沒有取得對方同意，所以我把提問者遮住。他先感謝影片，接著提出問題。

cues.en: Why are you defining Rack Search as a tool instead of an AI contact provider like TechSearchProvider?
cues.zh: 為什麼把 RAG 搜尋定義成工具，而不是使用 TextSearchProvider 這類 AI Context Provider？

cues.en: I will get into what this is with an example in one second.
cues.zh: 稍後會用範例解釋這是什麼。

cues.en: And then I mentioned, yes, it could be done, but why turn four simple lines of code into something much more complex with AI contact provider?
cues.zh: 我回答：可以這樣做，但為什麼要把四行簡單程式碼，變成更複雜的 AI Context Provider？

cues.en: And then I give sort of the main reason for this video, so I'm taking it out so no spoilers here.
cues.zh: 接著我提到這支影片的主要理由，不過先拿掉，避免劇透。

cues.en: And then I mentioned what I use AI contact providers for, like memory extraction, and I have a dedicated video about that as well.
cues.zh: 之後說明我使用 AI Context Provider 的情況，例如記憶擷取，也有專門影片介紹。

cues.en: So, but the person comes back, and this is what mainly sparked this video, not because this person is misinformed in any way,
cues.zh: 對方再次回覆，這就是這支影片的主要起因。並不是說他不懂，

cues.en: but because this is a very common thing that people misunderstand.
cues.zh: 而是這真的非常容易誤解。

cues.en: And that is, my concern is that the tool requires an additional round trip to the model, so we use more latency, I get additional usage.
cues.zh: 他擔心工具需要多一次往返模型的請求，因此增加延遲與使用量。

cues.en: That's why I said here, that's the common misconception.
cues.zh: 所以我說，這是常見的誤解。

cues.en: I will make videos about it soon, meaning this video, and then I explain a bit more what's going on in this video.
cues.zh: 我會很快製作影片，也就是這支影片，並在其中更詳細解釋。

cues.en: But they come back again.
cues.zh: 不過對方又回覆，

cues.en: But AI contact provider is automatically invoked at the start of the request.
cues.zh: AI Context Provider 會在請求開始時自動執行。

cues.en: It does not invoke a request to the model.
cues.zh: 它不會對模型發出請求。

cues.en: I mean, we don't see it in the additional traces, so they can't see that the model does anything special.
cues.zh: 也就是在額外追蹤記錄中，看不到模型執行任何特別操作。

cues.en: It doesn't call a tool or whatever.
cues.zh: 沒有工具呼叫之類的內容。

cues.en: It just magically do it, and I don't believe in magic in this regard at least.
cues.zh: 它彷彿自動完成了，但至少在這件事上，我不相信魔法。

cues.en: Because what most people think is that they just define some tools, which is, for them, I'm putting this in quotation marks, the old way of doing things.
cues.zh: 很多人以為，直接定義工具是所謂「舊方法」，這裡我特別加上引號。

cues.en: They can do MCPs, but they shouldn't because they are too expensive now.
cues.zh: 雖然也能使用 MCP，但現在太貴了，不應該用。

cues.en: Everything should just be skills and AI contact providers.
cues.zh: 所有功能都應該改用技能與 AI Context Provider。

cues.en: And the LLM will receive the skills and the contact providers as their delivery methods, and plus the messages that are being sent.
cues.zh: LLM 會收到技能、Context Provider 提供的內容，以及要傳送的訊息。

cues.en: And then the LLM will magically do things.
cues.zh: 接著 LLM 就會神奇地完成工作。

cues.en: And this is absolutely not how it works.
cues.zh: 但實際運作絕對不是如此。

cues.en: I have an updated version of this in one second, but let's see some code in order to back up my claims here.
cues.zh: 稍後會修正這張圖，先用程式碼支持我的說明。

cues.en: So I've made a small project here called Tools vs. MCPs vs. Skills vs. AI contact only.
cues.zh: 這裡建立了小專案，叫 Tools vs MCPs vs Skills vs AI Context Only。

cues.en: And I have three scenarios.
cues.zh: 準備了三種情境。

cues.en: So first up, why does MCP service have such a bad rep now?
cues.zh: 首先，為什麼 MCP 服務現在的名聲不太好？

cues.en: So let's set a breakpoint here.
cues.zh: 先在這裡設中斷點。

cues.en: Let's actually just run it so we can see what's going on.
cues.zh: 直接執行，看看發生什麼事。

cues.en: I will comment out the two other ones here.
cues.zh: 先把另外兩個情境註解掉。

cues.en: So it is now running.
cues.zh: 現在開始執行。

cues.en: It has a small chat loop, and I can just say hi.
cues.zh: 裡面有簡單對話迴圈，我只說一聲你好。

cues.en: And let's just quickly have a look.
cues.zh: 快速查看一下。

cues.en: What I'm actually doing here is the same as what I did in my MCP tools video,
cues.zh: 這裡其實和 MCP 工具影片中的做法一樣，

cues.en: where I make an MCP client, use it together with the GitHub MCP,
cues.zh: 建立 MCP 用戶端，連接 GitHub MCP，

cues.en: and then I'm just giving that MCP as tools down here, because that's how you turn an MCP server into a tool.
cues.zh: 再把 MCP 公開的工具提供給代理程式，這就是把 MCP 伺服器轉成工具的方式。

cues.en: And what people will see and be horrified about if I say hi,
cues.zh: 當我只說你好時，大家看到的結果可能會嚇一跳，

cues.en: you'll see that hi takes up 8,458 tokens.
cues.zh: 因為這聲你好花了 8,458 個 Token。

cues.en: So yes, by this account, tools like this, MCP tools, are horrible.
cues.zh: 所以只看這個結果，這類 MCP 工具確實很糟。

cues.en: But that's mostly GitHub's fault, because if we have a look,
cues.zh: 但主要問題在 GitHub 本身，因為實際查看，

cues.en: and have a look at what tools they actually give us, they give us 44 different tools.
cues.zh: 它提供了 44 個不同工具。

cues.en: 44 tools is quite a lot in an MCP server.
cues.zh: 對一個 MCP 伺服器來說，44 個工具很多。

cues.en: Most have three or five, three, four, five tools.
cues.zh: 多數通常只有三到五個。

cues.en: Three, four, five tools.
cues.zh: 也就是三、四、五個工具。

cues.en: And you can see they have very, very long descriptions, and each one of them takes a lot of additional,
cues.zh: 而且可以看到，工具描述非常長，每個工具也需要很多額外資訊，

cues.en: not this one, but others, takes a lot of properties in order to work.
cues.zh: 不是這個，但其他工具有大量屬性才能運作。

cues.en: So this is, in my opinion, an MCP done wrong.
cues.zh: 因此在我看來，這是 MCP 使用不當的例子。

cues.en: Because MCP should be a fairly simple protocol, and this is, in my case, overusage.
cues.zh: MCP 原本應該是簡單的協定，這個例子對我的用途來說過度了。

cues.en: Or you can argue that MCP for GitHub is quite a lot, because GitHub can do a lot of things.
cues.zh: 當然也可以說，GitHub 能做很多事情，所以 GitHub MCP 工具很多很合理。

cues.en: So if you use all these, then it makes sense.
cues.zh: 如果真的全部都用得到，那就有意義。

cues.en: But if you just use only things for issue, then it's your responsibility to not just go in and give all 44 tools,
cues.zh: 但如果只處理 Issue，就應該自己負責篩選，而不是直接提供全部 44 個工具。

cues.en: filter them down by names in here about issues, and then you get a smaller list, and therefore less tokens.
cues.zh: 在這裡依 Issue 相關名稱篩選，清單變小，Token 就會減少。

cues.en: So MCPs are just tools, and in some cases, many people went overboard with their MCP,
cues.zh: 所以 MCP 本質上只是工具。有些人把 MCP 做得過於龐大，

cues.en: and added too many tools, and that was the reason we ended up with this.
cues.zh: 加入太多工具，才造成這個結果。

cues.en: So that's the MCP part.
cues.zh: 這就是 MCP 的部分。

cues.en: Of course, then we have the skills. I will come in.
cues.zh: 接著當然還有技能，我先……

cues.en: Yeah, let's take skills first, so we can see it.
cues.zh: 先看技能的運作。

cues.en: So skills, how do they work?
cues.zh: 技能究竟如何運作？

cues.en: Because if we look into here, many people just think that LLMs now know the concept of skills.
cues.zh: 很多人以為 LLM 現在本身就理解技能這個概念。

cues.en: The concept of skills, but that's not the case.
cues.zh: 但其實不是這樣。

cues.en: So if we comment out this, and set a breakpoint here inside, we will see what's going on.
cues.zh: 把這段註解掉，再在裡面設中斷點，就能看到過程。

cues.en: I have a little thing where we can actually go in and see the raw request and responses.
cues.zh: 我也加了一個功能，可以查看原始請求與回應。

cues.en: We will see them a little later, once we have run this tool once.
cues.zh: 先執行一次工具，稍後再看這些內容。

cues.en: And I will actually also, for the sake of it,
cues.zh: 另外，為了方便示範，

cues.en: just comment out one line here,
cues.zh: 先註解掉這一行，

cues.en: before we do that.
cues.zh: 再繼續。

cues.en: So I don't want to show the tools right now.
cues.zh: 目前先不要顯示工具細節。

cues.en: So in this case, this one is set to go in and ask, what are the company values?
cues.zh: 這個範例會詢問：公司的價值觀是什麼？

cues.en: It has been given some skills, and these skills are in here.
cues.zh: 代理程式已經取得一些技能，技能在這裡。

cues.en: I have an employee handbook with some reference things here, and I have a secret formula skill, and I have a speak like a pirate skill.
cues.zh: 有員工手冊與參考文件、秘密公式技能，以及海盜說話技能。

cues.en: In this case, we are asking for what are the company values.
cues.zh: 這次詢問公司的價值觀。

cues.en: And this skill in here will have something with culture and values.
cues.zh: 這個技能中有文化與價值觀的資料。

cues.en: So we will guess that the LLM magically, again, reads this and can write CR values.
cues.zh: 看起來像 LLM 神奇地讀取這些內容，然後回答公司價值觀。

cues.en: And if we just look at the output, it could.
cues.zh: 如果只看輸出，確實像是如此。

cues.en: But what happens behind the scenes here is actually tools.
cues.zh: 但背後真正使用的仍然是工具。

cues.en: And we can see that by going in to this and turning on tool colon middleware.
cues.zh: 打開工具呼叫中介軟體，就能看到。

cues.en: So it will write out whenever a tool is called.
cues.zh: 每次呼叫工具，都會輸出記錄。

cues.en: And we will then see that what actually happens, let it run and ask for company values again.
cues.zh: 讓它重新執行，再問一次公司價值觀，就能看到實際過程。

cues.en: It will actually load the skill using a tool call, and it will actually use one more tool to read the resources.
cues.zh: 它會先透過工具呼叫載入技能，再使用另一個工具讀取資源。

cues.en: So it still do tools.
cues.zh: 因此仍然在使用工具。

cues.en: Those tools will cause tokens like normal.
cues.zh: 這些工具也一樣會花費 Token。

cues.en: So in that regard, it's not better than an MCP server with two tools.
cues.zh: 所以從這點來說，它不比有兩個工具的 MCP 伺服器更省。

cues.en: But where it is different is if we go in and put on that, we can see every single little thing that's happening.
cues.zh: 真正的差別，可以開啟這個設定，查看每個細節。

cues.en: So now we are also printing out the raw responses, and they are a bit big.
cues.zh: 現在也會輸出原始回應，內容有點多。

cues.en: So we will scroll up here at the top. And see.
cues.zh: 捲到最上面看看。

cues.en: So what is happening behind the scenes is our AI context provider here, AI skills.
cues.zh: 背後的處理來自這裡的 AI Context Provider，也就是 AI Skills。

cues.en: Go in and look inside that.
cues.zh: 進去看看。

cues.en: Just looking at the metadata.
cues.zh: 這裡先查看中繼資料。

cues.en: It is just an AI contact provider like any.
cues.zh: 它就是一般的 AI Context Provider。

cues.en: And it has various different options to do various different tools.
cues.zh: 提供各種設定，用來建立不同工具。

cues.en: So it will make tool calling.
cues.zh: 因此會執行工具呼叫。

cues.en: And when we find the...
cues.zh: 接著找到……

cues.en: To find the provide context.
cues.zh: 找到 ProvideContext。

cues.en: It will build a set of tools and will build a set of instructions.
cues.zh: 它會建立一組工具，以及一組指示。

cues.en: Instructions will be all the skills in my case.
cues.zh: 在這個例子中，指示會涵蓋所有技能。

cues.en: All their names and descriptions are on the fly being built into the instructions.
cues.zh: 各技能的名稱與描述，會在執行時加入指示。

cues.en: And it will build in tools for the various things that we need to do for each skill.
cues.zh: 也會加入工具，用來處理技能中的各種操作。

cues.en: And in order to load the skill, load resources from the skill, run scripts from the skill.
cues.zh: 包括載入技能、讀取技能資源，以及執行技能指令碼。

cues.en: So it builds up essentially three tools that we need to send.
cues.zh: 因此基本上會建立三個要送出的工具。

cues.en: And we can see that inside the call.
cues.zh: 實際請求中也能看到。

cues.en: So we can see we have tools here.
cues.zh: 可以看到這裡有 tools。

cues.en: We have a load skill tool.
cues.zh: 有載入技能的工具，

cues.en: We have a read resource skill tool, and we have a run script tool.
cues.zh: 讀取資源的工具，以及執行指令碼的工具。

cues.en: And then in the instructions, despite my small instructions, you are a nice AI, it embed
cues.zh: 而在指示中，除了我那句簡短的「你是友善的 AI」，也把，

cues.en: all this into it as well.
cues.zh: 這整段加入進去。

cues.en: Embed all this into it as well.
cues.zh: 這整段也都嵌入其中。

cues.en: That tells what each skill is called and it's a description.
cues.zh: 說明每個技能的名稱與描述。

cues.en: So essentially, the AI context provider is just a different way of bundling up
cues.zh: 所以 AI Context Provider 本質上只是另一種包裝，

cues.en: skills, instructions, and tools.
cues.zh: 技能、指示與工具的方式。

cues.en: And in my case, I need to set up that it shouldn't ask for approval on them and so on.
cues.zh: 這個例子中，也必須設定不要要求工具核准等等。

cues.en: So often this can take quite a while to set up and it's kind of magic what happens because
cues.zh: 因此設定有時會花不少時間，背後的處理也有點像黑箱，因為，

cues.en: when I did this the first time, and I didn't really know that it was tool approval, I saw this.
cues.zh: 第一次做時，我不知道它在要求工具核准，就看到這個結果。

cues.en: Came in.
cues.zh: 回應出來了。

cues.en: Let me disable this so it's a little easier to see what actually happens.
cues.zh: 先關掉這個，讓實際結果更容易看清楚。

cues.en: I saw this, like no text back.
cues.zh: 我當時看到的是，完全沒有回傳文字。

cues.en: And when you outsource all this code, in my opinion at least, you end up missing the points
cues.zh: 至少在我看來，把這些程式碼都交給框架處理後，就很容易錯過，

cues.en: of many of the things that was going on.
cues.zh: 許多背後真正發生的事情。

cues.en: So I needed to turn them off, else I would need to have that response would only be a
cues.zh: 所以我必須關閉核准，不然回應只會是一個，

cues.en: a tool request approval that I needed to take care of as well.
cues.zh: 需要另外處理的工具核准要求。

cues.en: That's a matter of opinion on how things should work, of course.
cues.zh: 當然，這是對系統應該如何運作的設計取捨。

cues.en: But I tend to feel like this is too much of bundling and that's also why my own implementation
cues.zh: 但我覺得這裡包裝過多，因此自己的，

cues.en: of agent skills is quite different, where I go in and say I get the skills and you can say then get instructions.
cues.zh: 技能實作很不一樣：先取得技能，再選擇取得指示。

cues.en: Then you can use those instructions directly in yourself in however you want it and not just the way the Microsoft Agent Fragments version does it.
cues.zh: 你可以依自己的方式使用指示，而不必局限於 Microsoft Agent Framework 官方版本的做法。

cues.en: And then my agent skills can say get us tools.
cues.zh: 接著也可以從我的技能物件取得工具。

cues.en: So this is a more manual approach, but it's in my opinion a less easier to understand approach.
cues.zh: 這是比較手動的做法，但我認為更容易理解。

cues.en: And you can take these tools and put them into approval mode if you need to or not, instead of needing to do it by additional settings.
cues.zh: 工具要不要加入核准機制，也能自行決定，不必透過額外設定調整。

cues.en: It's a matter of opinion, but the main point here is that skills are actually just tools as well.
cues.zh: 這是設計取捨，但重點是：技能本質上也只是工具。

cues.en: It's just a better, a smaller tool that uses less tokens because it only loads in an MCP.

cues.en: AI Context Providers are cool.
cues.zh: AI Context Provider 是很好的功能。

cues.en: Skills are cool. MCPs are cool. Tools are cool.
cues.zh: 技能、MCP 與工具，也都是很好的功能。

cues.en: But behind the scenes, everything becomes a tool.
cues.zh: 不過背後最後仍然會轉成工具。

cues.en: So you can jokingly say it's like a turtle's all the way down.
cues.zh: 可以開玩笑說，就像「一路往下都是烏龜」的比喻。

cues.en: It's tools all the way down to the LLM.
cues.zh: 一路往下直到 LLM，都是工具。

cues.en: So LLM, by its technical nature, have no clue what an MCP server is.
cues.zh: 所以從技術上來說，LLM 並不知道 MCP 伺服器是什麼。

cues.en: Have no clue what a skill is.
cues.zh: 也不知道技能是什麼。

cues.en: No clue what an AI Context Provider is.
cues.zh: 更不知道 AI Context Provider 是什麼。

cues.en: All turned into tools.
cues.zh: 它們最後都會轉成工具。

cues.en: That is the big misconception I have seen from a lot of people when they talk about these.
cues.zh: 這就是我看到很多人在討論這些機制時，最大的誤解。

cues.en: So if you have a good MCP and it has a few good tools, don't be worried about token cost.
cues.zh: 因此如果 MCP 設計得好，只有少數好用的工具，就不必過度擔心 Token 費用。

cues.en: It would be just as much if you used the skill at all.
cues.zh: 如果技能真的被使用，花費也差不多。

cues.en: Making tools on your own is easier in some cases compared to an AI Context Provider.
cues.zh: 某些情況下，自行建立工具比使用 AI Context Provider 更簡單。

cues.en: So you don't need to put everything into an AI Context Provider just to get one tool into the tool system when you have the direct tool option.
cues.zh: 既然可以直接提供工具，就不需要只是為了加入一個工具，而把所有事情包進 AI Context Provider。

cues.en: So I hope this clears up a lot of things for people who are confused about these different cases.
cues.zh: 希望這能釐清大家對這些不同情況的疑惑。

cues.en: I hope my person who got asked the question will see this video and understand why I
cues.zh: 也希望前面提問的那位觀眾看到影片後，能理解為什麼我，

cues.en: wanted to go this route and why I did the way I did.
cues.zh: 選擇這條路，以及採用原本的做法。

cues.en: Again, I'm not against any of the other tools.
cues.zh: 再次強調，我不是反對其他工具。

cues.en: I'm just feeling that use the right tool for the job.
cues.zh: 只是認為，應該為工作選擇合適的工具。

cues.en: Feeling that use the right tool for the job.
cues.zh: 也就是選擇適合當下工作的工具。

cues.en: And in my case, an AI Context Provider was overkill in that video.
cues.zh: 在那支影片中，AI Context Provider 對我的需求來說過於複雜。

cues.en: And a skills implementation can be done both with AI Context Providers.
cues.zh: 技能確實也能透過 AI Context Provider 實作。

cues.en: But in my case, I feel like I like having more control.
cues.zh: 但我自己希望保留更多控制權。

cues.en: And the more you bundle and abstract things away, the less control you have.
cues.zh: 封裝與抽象越多，能直接掌握的細節就越少。

cues.en: And that's a matter of opinion.
cues.zh: 這是個人的設計偏好。

cues.en: Not against the way things are being done, but it's just a matter of opinion.
cues.zh: 我並不反對其他做法，只是有不同看法。

cues.en: And the most important thing is you understand what's going on behind the scenes.
cues.zh: 最重要的是，理解背後真正發生什麼事。

cues.en: And I hope this video did that.
cues.zh: 希望這支影片有達成這個目標。

cues.en: So that's everything.
cues.zh: 這次的內容就是這些。

cues.en: See you in the next one.
cues.zh: 下一支影片見。
